caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a metal candle holder with a tall, thin, vertical stand. At the top, there is a white candle inserted into a black candle socket. The upper part of the stand features simple geometric supports beneath the socket, including two diagonal cross bars set within a rectangular frame. A curved metal hook or handle is attached to one side near the top. The base consists of three arched legs that curve outward, providing stability. The overall color palette includes shades of brown and gray for the metal, with the candle being white and the background a plain, lightly speckled beige or off-white. There are no additional objects, and the background is otherwise empty. Handwritten text appears lightly at the bottom of the drawing.
title: Adjustable Candle Holder
